method: Same generated PE per size, early 1-update recording then coverage/all, sequential shared-machine builds; cache states in build; 300 per-update trace hashes identical, no GPU rasterization. Not cold/idle speed claims.

memory.scope: heavy-gate physical headroom at phase entry; not a reservation

build.phase_timing_scope: phase wall times except C generation: summed child CPU, nested within lift (which reanalyzes); not additive
build.wasm_bytes_per_insn_scope: total module including profile/asyncify; not marginal lifted-code cost
